explanation: This method uses %d percent-formatting to build a DELETE query (a CWE-89 anti-pattern), although %d enforces integer input at runtime. The repair passes params=[userid,friendid] to sql.deleteDB(), but mistakenly leaves userid=%d unadjusted in sqlText while changing only friendid to %s, causing a placeholder mismatch in standard DB-API drivers, and sql.deleteDB is not shown.
